title: Centre Tank Boost Pump — Installation

issue.reason: Original issue of the centre tank boost pump installation task.

abstract: Installation of a centre tank boost pump with its fine mesh inlet screen, including the outlet heat exchanger shim, the screen cleaning interval and the high flow operational check that closes the task.

sections.purpose: This task gives the installation of one centre tank boost pump with its screen carrier and fine mesh inlet screen, and the high flow operational check that verifies the inlet pressure margin.
sections.job_setup_note: The tank must still be gas-free and the tool control card must be re-started for the installation. The high flow check needs the aircraft refuelled to at least the centre tank half level.
sections.procedure: 1. WARNING: DO NOT ENTER THE FUEL TANK UNTIL THE GAS-FREE READING IS CONFIRMED AND A SECOND PERSON IS AT THE ACCESS PANEL. 2. Confirm the gas-free reading and log every tool taken into the tank. 3. Remove the tank blank from the pump aperture and clean the mounting face. 4. Assemble the inlet screen into the screen carrier. 5. CAUTION: DO NOT DISTORT THE SCREEN MESH WHILE IT IS BEING SEATED. A LOCAL DISTORTION IS A REJECTION. 6. Offer the pump and carrier into the aperture and install the mounting fasteners to the torque given in the task. 7. Measure the gap at the outlet heat exchanger D2820117029234 and select the shim from the shim set. 8. Install the shim and check the clearance to the inlet manifold CIN652579-17. 9. Connect the electrical connector at the pump inlet actuator D2820111798703 and lock it. 10. Enter the next screen cleaning due point in the aircraft maintenance record at 1 200 flight hours from this installation. 11. Remove the tool control card items and confirm the count before the access panel is closed. 12. Close the tank, refuel to at least the centre tank half level and do the fuel system leak check. 13. Do the boost pump operational check at high flow and confirm the inlet pressure stays above the low pressure warning threshold.
sections.close_out: Confirm the tool count against the tool control card before the access panel is closed. Do the fuel leak check with the tank pressurised and hold for fifteen minutes. Record the selected shim thickness, the pump serial number, the screen cleaning due point and the high flow check result in the aircraft technical record.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The inlet screen cleaning interval is 1 200 flight hours.

safety_precautions: Do not enter the tank until the gas-free reading is confirmed.
Keep a second person at the access panel with the recovery harness.
Confirm the tool count before the access panel is closed.

title: Centre Tank Boost Pump — Installation

issue.reason: Coarse mesh screen added as a selectable standard and the cleaning interval recalculated from its open area.

abstract: Installation of a centre tank boost pump with the applicable inlet screen, including the shim measurement at the outlet heat exchanger and the high flow operational check that closes the task.

sections.purpose: This task gives the installation of one centre tank boost pump with its screen carrier and inlet screen, and the high flow operational check that verifies the inlet pressure margin.
sections.job_setup_note: The tank must still be gas-free and the tool control card must be re-started for the installation. The screen carrier length depends on the fitted screen standard, so the outlet heat exchanger shim has to be measured on the aircraft rather than taken from a previous record. The high flow check needs the aircraft refuelled to at least the centre tank half level.
sections.procedure: 1. WARNING: DO NOT ENTER THE FUEL TANK UNTIL THE GAS-FREE READING IS CONFIRMED AND A SECOND PERSON IS AT THE ACCESS PANEL. 2. Confirm the gas-free reading and log every tool taken into the tank. 3. Remove the tank blank from the pump aperture and clean the mounting face. 4. Assemble the inlet screen into the screen carrier and confirm the screen standard against the work card. 5. CAUTION: DO NOT MIX SCREEN STANDARDS BETWEEN THE TWO CENTRE TANK PUMPS UNLESS THE WORK CARD ALLOWS IT. 6. Offer the pump and carrier into the aperture and install the mounting fasteners to the torque given in the task. 7. Measure the gap at the outlet heat exchanger D2820117029234 and select the shim from the shim set. 8. Install the shim and check the clearance to the inlet manifold CIN652579-17. 9. Connect the electrical connector at the pump inlet actuator D2820111798703 and lock it. 10. Enter the next screen cleaning due point for the standard installed: 1 200 flight hours for the fine mesh screen and 3 600 flight hours for the coarse mesh screen. The coarse screen has four times the open area of the fine screen, so the same interval on it would take the aircraft into a tank entry that finds nothing, while the fine interval left on a coarse installation is simply the wrong number in the record. 11. Remove the tool control card items and confirm the count before the access panel is closed. 12. Close the tank, refuel to at least the centre tank half level and do the fuel system leak check. 13. Do the boost pump operational check at high flow and confirm the inlet pressure stays above the low pressure warning threshold, and read the inlet pressure at the pressure decay form of the check rather than at the flow figure used before.
sections.close_out: Confirm the tool count against the tool control card before the access panel is closed. Do the fuel leak check with the tank pressurised and hold for fifteen minutes. Record the installed screen standard, the selected shim thickness, the pump serial number, the cleaning due point derived from that standard and the high flow check result in the aircraft technical record.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. Select the inlet screen standard from the work card; the carrier length and therefore the shim differ between standards, and the cleaning interval is 1 200 flight hours on the fine mesh screen and 3 600 on the coarse.

safety_precautions: Do not enter the tank until the gas-free reading is confirmed.
Keep a second person at the access panel with the recovery harness.
Confirm the tool count before the access panel is closed.
